title: P.8 Sequences; Summation Notation; the Binomial Theorem

icans: I can write the terms of a sequence, including a recursive sequence.
I can use summation notation and find sums.
I can evaluate binomial coefficients and expand binomials with the Binomial Theorem.

vocab: a ___________ whose domain is the set of positive integers
a sequence given by its first __________(s) and a rule for each term from the ones before it

blocks.p: Build Pascal’s triangle (row 0: 1;  row 1: 1 1), then expand.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Sequences: {sₙ} lists s₁, s₂, s₃, …; the domain is the _______________ integers.

blocks.stem:
Write the first five terms.
a.  aₙ = n/(n + 1)
b.  bₙ = (−1)ⁿn²

Write the first five terms.
a.  a₁ = 2, aₙ = n + aₙ₋₁
b.  a₁ = 1, aₙ = 3aₙ₋₁

notes: Summation properties: Σ c = nc, Σ k = n(n + 1)/2, Σ k² = _______________ (each sum from k = 1 to n).

blocks.stem:
Find each sum.
a.  Σ (2k − 1), k = 1 to 100
b.  Σ (4k + 3), k = 1 to 18

notes: Binomial Theorem: (x + a)ⁿ = Σ C(n, j) aʲ xⁿ⁻ʲ, j = 0 to n: the coefficients are row n of _______________ triangle.

blocks.stem: Find Σ 6 (k = 1 to 50) and Σ 3k (k = 1 to 30).
